title: dhammassavana sutta
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

pañc’ime.label: two words joined (sandhi)
pañc’ime.note: The final a of pañca drops before the vowel of ime.

parts.label: pronoun · masculine nominative plural of ima

bhikkhave.label: masculine noun · vocative plural
bhikkhave.dpd: monk; monastic; mendicant; fully ordained monk
bhikkhave.note: bhikkhave and bhikkhavo are two vocative plural forms of bhikkhu.

heads.meaning: monk; monastic; mendicant; fully ordained monk

ānisaṃsā.label: masculine noun · nominative plural
ānisaṃsā.note: It takes the locative: ānisaṃsā dhammassavane, “benefits in listening to the Dhamma”.

dhamma-ssavane.label: neuter noun · locative singular
dhamma-ssavane.dpd: hearing the teaching; hearing a sermon; listening to the Dhamma
dhamma-ssavane.note: Where the two words join, s doubles: dhamma + savana → dhammassavana.

heads.meaning: hearing the teaching; hearing a sermon; listening to the Dhamma

cittam.note: cittaṃ is written cittam before a vowel (here before assa).

assa.label: pronoun · masculine genitive singular
assa.note: Here assa means “of him, his”. Elsewhere assa can be the optative of atthi, “would be”.
